statements.subject: browser-acceptance
statements.statement: Commit e0a1eb4 was sample-accepted for the repaired strict-v2 collection in the local Codex In-app Browser with noAudio=1; the sample confirms the step-9 auto-advance interval but does not establish real-audio or long-soak acceptance.
evidence: Environment: Codex In-app Browser 26.803.41515, Microsoft Windows 10.0.22631.6199, local-dev
Fresh route load at start_step=8 reached progress 1/5 -> 2/5 in 543ms and 2/5 -> 3/5 in 652ms; the old 5.2-second wait was absent
noAudio kept AudioContext uninitialized and active audio sources at zero
Event 410001 detail rendered GROWING SIGN@L -Not Alone-, 世界を変えるユニット, and all 11 episode entries
Episode h direct entry rendered Spine/background/dialogue; phone Choice 大丈夫ですよ！ advanced from 1/21 to 2/21
Episode j Choice はい、行ってらっしゃい！ advanced from 1/3 to 2/3
Episode k rendered the live-stage scene and the player return restored Event 410001 detail context
Error-level application console entries: 0; existing Pixi Spine update/tint warnings remained without a visible playback failure
Exact publish -> rollback -> republish was completed before this browser sample
Real audio, deployed consumers, and long soak were not tested
